name: Answer instant messaging
syntax: answer instant messaging
doc: Answers the instant message interaction. If it succeeds, the state changes from alerting to connected.

name: Clear instant messaging
syntax: clear instant messaging
doc: Clears the instant message interaction. If it succeeds, the state changes from wrapUp to cleared.

name: Disconnect instant messaging
syntax: disconnect instant messaging
doc: Ends the instant messaging interaction. If it succeeds, the state changes from connected to wrapUp.

name: Retrieve instant messaging
syntax: retrieve instant messaging
doc: Retrieves a held or extended instant messaging interaction. If it succeeds, the state changes from held or extended to connected.

name: Transfer instant messaging
syntax: transfer instant messaging
doc: Transfers an extended instant messaging interaction. If it succeeds, the state changes from extended to cleared.

name: Conference instant messaging
syntax: conference instant messaging
doc: Establishes an instant messaging conference with the contact and the extended call. If it succeeds, the state changes from extended to connected.

name: Blind transfer instant messaging
syntax: blind transfer instant messaging [to agent Text] [to campaign Text] [directory Text] [contact profile unique id Text] [transfer values ATTRIBUTE,...]
doc: Transfers a connected instant messaging interaction. If successful, the agent state changes from connected to cleared.

name: Extend instant messaging
syntax: extend instant messaging [to agent Text] [to campaign Text] [directory Text] [contact profile unique id Text] [transfer values ATTRIBUTE,...]
extend instant messaging [to agent Text] [to campaign Text] [external data Bytestream]
doc: Extends a connected instant messaging interaction. If successful, the state changes from connected to held and then to extended when the third party answers.

name: Divert instant messaging
syntax: divert instant messaging to dnis Integer [directory Text] [contact profile unique id Text] [transfer values ATTRIBUTE,...]
doc: Diverts an instant messaging to another campaign.

syntax: start instant messaging with [agent Text] [campaign Text] [media name Text] [transfer values ATTRIBUTE,...]
start instant messaging with [agent Text] [campaign Text] [external data Bytestream]
doc: Creates a new instant messaging interaction with an agent.

name: Send instant message

doc: Sends an instant message in the context of the current conversation. Only possible when the instant messaging interaction is connected.

doc: Sends an outbound instant message to a customer.

name: Save transcript

doc: Saves the conversation transcript between the agent and the customer.

name: Send message
syntax: media panel chat send message Text
doc: Sends a message in the context of the current conversation. Only possible on state connected.

doc: Only for human agent scripts. Answers a workflow interaction. Routing scripts automatically answer workflow interactions. The action does not work with IVR agents.

doc: Cancels the reservation state for the current workflow interaction.

doc: Only for human agent scripts. Picks up the workflow task with identifier Integer from the queue.
